Captions.ai is an AI video editor that turns your footage into a fully edited video, ready to share [1]. VEXI makes and posts your social content. They overlap on video, and in many ways they fit together.

Captions.ai (Captions) is an AI video editor that produces fully edited videos: upload footage and AI Edit cuts scenes, overlays B-roll and adds music, transitions and captions, or generate new footage with AI avatars and your own AI twin [1]. It adds auto-captions in 100+ styles and translated subtitles in 100+ languages, and its Clips feature turns one long video into up to 30+ ready-to-post clips [1][5]. Captions also has a real estate page for listing videos, neighborhood tours and market updates [6]. It is free to sign up, and paid plans include Basic at $9.99, Max at $24.99 and Frontier from $69.99 a month, paid monthly or yearly [2][4].

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.
The two overlap on video and do different main jobs. Here is what each one does.
Captions edits your footage with AI Edit styles, B-roll, music and transitions, and makes new videos from a prompt or a script with AI actors or your own AI twin [1][3].
VEXI edits the video too, then schedules and posts it.
Captions’ Clips takes a video of up to 3 hours, finds the moments worth sharing, frames them for vertical or horizontal formats, ranks them for virality and gives you up to 30+ clips [5].
Captions turns listing photos or links into listing videos, helps agents make neighborhood tours and market updates, and exports the right specs for Instagram Reels, Facebook and more [6].

Captions is an AI video editor that produces fully edited videos: you upload footage and use its AI editing tools to finish it, or generate new footage without recording yourself [1]. You can use it on your phone or computer [1].
Can Captions.ai turn a long video into clips?
Yes. Captions’ Clips takes a link or an upload of up to 3 hours or 10 GB, finds the moments worth sharing and gives you up to 30+ edited clips, ranked by how likely they are to perform [5].
Does Captions.ai work for real estate videos?
Yes. Captions has a real estate page: it turns listing photos or links into listing videos, and helps agents make neighborhood tours, market updates and agent branding videos [6].
